nodes.label: honeypot_error.html
nodes.rationale: Terse 400 response on purpose: whoever triggers the trap is not told how to avoid it.

nodes.label: honeypot_field.html
nodes.rationale: Trap field hidden via opacity/position rather than display:none so bots inspecting styles do not skip it; label tells screen-reader users to leave it blank.

nodes.label: Public case query portal (consultar_proceso.html)
nodes.rationale: Server-rendered via Django escaping instead of innerHTML over localStorage data; extends pages/index.html so it looks like the rest of the site instead of a standalone page with 1,782 lines of CSS.

nodes.label: DataTables JS partial
nodes.rationale: pdfmake loaded before DataTables since PDF button binds at construction; no jQuery (DataTables 2 native API); i18n strings kept in the HTML template because makemessages only scans .html.

nodes.label: Portfolio financial status partial
nodes.rationale: Ring chart is a CSS conic-gradient instead of Chart.js (~200 KB), keeping financial figures in Django-escaped HTML rather than passing them through JavaScript.

nodes.label: Legal notice accordion partial
nodes.rationale: Approved legal text kept verbatim; eleven custom notaPortalV77 classes replaced by a Bootstrap accordion so legal text collapses; ad-hoc unicode glyphs replaced by Bootstrap Icons.

nodes.label: login_otp.html (OTP email)
nodes.rationale: Tables + inline styles for Gmail/Outlook compatibility; letterhead via cid: attachment since remote images are blocked; code as text so it can be copied and read by screen readers.

nodes.label: account/layout/account.html
nodes.rationale: Extends base.html without header/footer so users focus on the single task; assets served from vendor/ not CDN so login does not depend on third parties.

nodes.label: two_factor/_base.html
nodes.rationale: django-two-factor-auth makes all its screens extend this template, so pointing it at the site layout restyles the library screens.

nodes.label: two_factor/core/login.html
nodes.rationale: Four faces (password, email code, token, backup); primary button first; screen-switch buttons use formnovalidate; field names auth-username/auth-password are read by axes_hooks.username; noindex to avoid inviting password guessing.

nodes.label: two_factor/_wizard_actions.html
nodes.rationale: Primary button placed first in HTML because the browser fires the first submit button on Enter.

nodes.label: two_factor/_wizard_forms.html
nodes.rationale: Uses as_div (Django 4.1+) to allow Bootstrap classes without wrapping each field.

nodes.label: /admin/login/ redirected to account login
nodes.rationale: Avoids a second door (Django admin) lacking email code, axes brake and 2FA.

nodes.label: Email one-time code login
nodes.rationale: Six-digit code to email offered on demand or after 3rd failed password; implemented as a wizard step so it never bypasses the second factor (a separate login() view would be a backdoor to TOTP).

nodes.label: No account enumeration
nodes.rationale: Screen answers identically whether the email exists or not.

nodes.label: Shared failed-attempt counter (django-axes)
nodes.rationale: Wrong codes count in axes like wrong passwords, otherwise the 5-attempt cap per code could be bypassed by requesting new codes.

nodes.label: Two-factor login wizard (auth/otp/token/backup)
nodes.rationale: Single /accounts/login/ wizard from django-two-factor-auth; each user sees only the steps that apply; 2FA optional, registration public.

nodes.label: Required documents (power of attorney, service contract)
nodes.norm_label: required documents (power of attorney, service contract)

nodes.label: Template block hierarchy (raw -> base -> pages)
nodes.rationale: raw.html declares every overridable block (meta, css, js, header, main, footer) and includes toasts; base.html fills meta/fonts/favicon; pages fill layout blocks and include shared header/footer partials.
